name: FireShot
summary: Captures the visible area, a selection, or the full page, then annotates, saves or exports the result to PDF/PNG/clipboard or an external editor.
price: Freemium (free core; paid Pro per getfireshot.com)
license: Proprietary; no open-source license stated on the store page.
goodFor: Capturing, annotating and exporting visible, selected or full-page shots.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: screenshot capture annotate pdf png selection export
